market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI dip to $90 by May 31 from $101.94 needs ~-11.7%. Ceasefire-driven unwind plus weak demand could push prices lower but a >10% monthly drop is uncommon (~15-25% of months). Prior April low was ~$82.59, so feasible but requires sustained de-escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace and durability of geopolitical premium unwind.
